const { exec } = require('child_process');
const fs = require('fs');
const path = require('path');

const imgData = $input.first().json;
const imageUrls = imgData.imageUrls || [];
if (imageUrls.length === 0) throw new Error('No image URLs from Generate Images');

const keys = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync('/home/node/keys.json', 'utf8'));
const apiKey = keys.falApiKey;
if (!apiKey || apiKey === 'YOUR_FAL_API_KEY') throw new Error('falApiKey not set in keys.json');

const motions = [
  'slow cinematic zoom in, subtle atmospheric depth, particles floating',
  'gentle camera pan left to right, soft bokeh, cinematic color grade',
  'smooth dolly push forward, dramatic shadows shifting, epic scale',
  'slow zoom out revealing scene, ambient light rays, moody atmosphere',
  'camera orbit around subject, particle effects, cinematic depth of field',
  'gentle upward tilt, dramatic sky, sweeping cinematic movement'
];

const KLING_MODEL = 'fal-ai/kling-video/v1.6/standard/image-to-video';
const tmpDir = '/tmp/n8n_kling_' + Date.now();
fs.mkdirSync(tmpDir, { recursive: true });

try {
  const config = { imageUrls, motions, model: KLING_MODEL, apiKey, clipDuration: '5' };
  fs.writeFileSync(path.join(tmpDir, 'cfg.json'), JSON.stringify(config));

  const js = [
    "const https = require('https');",
    "const http = require('http');",
    "const fs = require('fs');",
    "const cfg = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(process.argv[2]+'/cfg.json','utf8'));",
    "const {imageUrls, motions, model, apiKey, clipDuration} = cfg;",
    "const sleep = ms => new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,ms));",
    "const MIN_CLIPS = 4;",
    "const POLL_TIMEOUT_MS = 3600000;",
    "",
    "function reqUrl(urlStr, method, body) {",
    "  return new Promise((res, rej) => {",
    "    const u = new URL(urlStr);",
    "    const b = body ? JSON.stringify(body) : null;",
    "    const headers = {'Authorization':'Key '+apiKey};",
    "    if (b) { headers['Content-Type']='application/json'; headers['Content-Length']=Buffer.byteLength(b); }",
    "    const lib = u.protocol === 'https:' ? https : http;",
    "    const r = lib.request({hostname:u.hostname, path:u.pathname+u.search, method, headers}, resp => {",
    "      const c=[]; resp.on('data',d=>c.push(d)); resp.on('end',()=>res({s:resp.statusCode,b:Buffer.concat(c).toString()}));",
    "    });",
    "    r.on('error',rej); if(b) r.write(b); r.end();",
    "  });",
    "}",
    "",
    "async function submitKling(imageUrl, prompt) {",
    "  const submitUrl = 'https://queue.fal.run/'+model;",
    "  const r = await reqUrl(submitUrl, 'POST', {image_url:imageUrl, prompt, duration:clipDuration, aspect_ratio:'9:16'});",
    "  if (r.s !== 200) throw new Error('Kling submit error '+r.s+': '+r.b.substring(0,300));",
    "  const data = JSON.parse(r.b);",
    "  // Use URLs returned by fal.ai directly — do not reconstruct manually",
    "  return { requestId: data.request_id, statusUrl: data.status_url, responseUrl: data.response_url };",
    "}",
    "",
    "async function pollKling(job, timeoutMs, clipNum) {",
    "  const label = 'Clip '+clipNum+':';",
    "  const start = Date.now();",
    "  while (Date.now()-start < timeoutMs) {",
    "    await sleep(8000);",
    "    const r = await reqUrl(job.statusUrl, 'GET', null);",
    "    if (r.s !== 200) { await sleep(5000); continue; }",
    "    const data = JSON.parse(r.b);",
    "    const status = data.status || (data.queue_position !== undefined ? 'IN_QUEUE' : '');",
    "    process.stderr.write('  '+label+' '+status+'\\n');",
    "    if (status === 'COMPLETED') {",
    "      const res = await reqUrl(job.responseUrl, 'GET', null);",
    "      const resData = JSON.parse(res.b);",
    "      return resData.video.url;",
    "    }",
    "    if (status === 'FAILED') throw new Error('Kling generation failed for '+job.requestId);",
    "  }",
    "  throw new Error('Kling timeout after '+(timeoutMs/1000)+'s for '+job.requestId);",
    "}",
    "",
    "async function processClip(imgUrl, motion, clipNum) {",
    "  // Submit + poll with one retry on failure",
    "  for (let attempt = 1; attempt <= 2; attempt++) {",
    "    try {",
    "      if (attempt > 1) process.stderr.write('  Clip '+clipNum+': retrying (attempt '+attempt+')...\\n');",
    "      const job = await submitKling(imgUrl, motion);",
    "      process.stderr.write('  Clip '+clipNum+' submitted: '+job.requestId.substring(0,16)+'... statusUrl: '+job.statusUrl+'\\n');",
    "      const url = await pollKling(job, POLL_TIMEOUT_MS, clipNum);",
    "      process.stderr.write('  Clip '+clipNum+' done: '+url.substring(0,80)+'\\n');",
    "      return url;",
    "    } catch(e) {",
    "      if (attempt === 2) throw e;",
    "      process.stderr.write('  Clip '+clipNum+' attempt '+attempt+' failed: '+e.message+' — retrying\\n');",
    "    }",
    "  }",
    "}",
    "",
    "async function main() {",
    "  process.stderr.write('Processing '+imageUrls.length+' clips in parallel...\\n');",
    "  const settlements = await Promise.allSettled(",
    "    imageUrls.map((imgUrl, i) => processClip(imgUrl, motions[i % motions.length], i+1))",
    "  );",
    "",
    "  const succeeded = settlements.filter(s => s.status === 'fulfilled');",
    "  const failed = settlements.filter(s => s.status === 'rejected');",
    "  failed.forEach(f => process.stderr.write('WARNING clip failed after retry: '+f.reason.message+'\\n'));",
    "",
    "  if (succeeded.length < MIN_CLIPS) {",
    "    throw new Error('Only '+succeeded.length+'/'+imageUrls.length+' clips completed (need '+MIN_CLIPS+'). Failures: '+failed.map(f=>f.reason.message).join('; '));",
    "  }",
    "",
    "  const videoUrls = succeeded.map(s => s.value);",
    "  process.stderr.write(succeeded.length+'/'+imageUrls.length+' clips completed\\n');",
    "  process.stdout.write(JSON.stringify({videoUrls, clipDurations: videoUrls.map(()=>5.0)}));",
    "}",
    "main().catch(e=>{process.stderr.write('FATAL: '+e.message+'\\n');process.exit(1);})"
  ];
  fs.writeFileSync(path.join(tmpDir, 'run.js'), js.join('\n'));

  const out = await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    exec('node "' + path.join(tmpDir, 'run.js') + '" "' + tmpDir + '"',
      { timeout: 9000000, maxBuffer: 10*1024*1024 },
      (err, stdout, stderr) => {
        if (err) { const fm=(stderr||'').match(/FATAL: ([\s\S]+)/); reject(new Error(fm?fm[1].trim():stderr||err.message)); }
        else resolve(stdout);
      });
  });

  const result = JSON.parse(out);
  return {
    json: {
      videoUrls: result.videoUrls,
      clipDurations: result.clipDurations,
      clipCount: result.videoUrls.length,
      script: imgData.script,
      title: imgData.title,
      description: imgData.description,
      tags: imgData.tags
    }
  };
} finally {
  try { fs.rmSync(tmpDir, {recursive:true, force:true}); } catch(e) {}
}
